name: market_token_klines
description: Get recent or historical token price klines. Use token for major assets like BTC or ETH, or use token_address plus chain for on-chain tokens. Provide from_timestamp and to_timestamp for historical klines, otherwise recent klines are returned.

token.description: Token symbol, name, or CoinGecko-style asset identifier for major assets. Example: BTC, ETH, Solana.

token_address.description: Contract or mint address for an on-chain token.

chain.description: Chain or network slug for token_address queries, such as ethereum, bsc, base, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche, solana, or bitcoin.

vs_currency.description: Quote fiat currency for the klines. Defaults to usd.

days.description: Recent range in days when querying latest klines without historical timestamps. Defaults to 1 and must be between 1 and 365.

from_timestamp.description: Historical range start as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Must be provided together with to_timestamp.

to_timestamp.description: Historical range end as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Must be provided together with from_timestamp.

interval.description: Optional candle interval. Supported values: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d. If omitted, the tool chooses a reasonable default from the requested range.

limit.description: Maximum number of candles to return, showing the latest candles from the requested range. Defaults to 24 and must be 100 or less.
